remarks: Spacious raised ranch in lovely Cranbury area of Norwalk. Large eat-in kitchen with engineered flooring leading to dining room or large outside deck. Central air conditioning (upper floor only). Family room lower level with wood burning fireplace to enjoy large family time gatherings. 4th bedroom can also be office, exercise, play room, or guest room! Attic is for landlord only. Two-car garage with auto door opener and extra storage space. Located close to Cranbury shopping center and park gives a great country feel! GOOD credit report and background check (provided to listing agent) to be PAID BY TENANT, along with 1st month's rent and Two months security.
